verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents consolidated billing across all providers in one place and usage tracking through its own analytics, and community users confirm consolidated billing. However, nothing in the evidence shows spend broken down by model, key, team, or user; workspace budgets and per-key limits are spend caps, not spend tracking. missing for 10: documented per-model spend breakdown, per-key spend reporting, per-team/workspace spend attribution, per-user spend attribution, programmatic usage/cost reporting API, hands-on corroboration of the analytics.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can track spend per model, key, team, or user across all providers in one place

citations.quote: It also allows users to aggregate their billing in one place and keep track of all of their usage using our analytics.
I'm happy to pay 5% extra for consolidated billing and usage limits.
